import argparse
import os
import json
import datetime as dt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def safe_divide(numer: pd.Series, denom: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    numer = numer.astype(float)
    denom = denom.astype(float)
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
        out = np.where(denom > 0, numer / denom, 0.0)
    return pd.Series(out, index=numer.index)


parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

# Load
df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

# Lightweight ID for downstream systems
df = df.reset_index().rename(columns={'index': 'student_id'})

# Columns used
col_target = 'Target'
col_app_order = 'Application order'
col_grade1 = 'Curricular units 1st sem (grade)'
col_eval1 = 'Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations)'
col_noeval1 = 'Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)'
col_enr1 = 'Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)'
col_approved1 = 'Curricular units 1st sem (approved)'
col_eval2 = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations)'
col_noeval2 = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'
col_enr2 = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'
col_approved2 = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'
col_debtor = 'Debtor'
col_tuition = 'Tuition fees up to date'
col_scholar = 'Scholarship holder'
col_unemp = 'Unemployment rate'

# Allowed labels for supervision/calibration
allowed_targets = {'Graduate', 'Dropout', 'Enrolled'}

# Validate label domain before use
# ASSERTION_START
assert df[col_target].isin(allowed_targets).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# Guard grade bounds before normalization
# ASSERTION_START
assert ((df[col_grade1] >= 0) & (df[col_grade1] <= 20)).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# Normalize grade to [0,1]
grade1_norm = (df[col_grade1] / 20.0).clip(0, 1)

# Semester 1 internal consistency before computing participation and pass rates
# ASSERTION_START
assert ((df[col_eval1] >= 0) & (df[col_noeval1] >= 0) & (df[col_enr1] >= 0) & (df[col_eval1] + df[col_noeval1] == df[col_enr1])).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# ASSERTION_START
assert ((df[col_approved1] >= 0) & (df[col_eval1] >= 0) & (df[col_approved1] <= df[col_eval1])).all()
# ASSERTION_END
sem1_participation = safe_divide(df[col_eval1], df[col_enr1])
sem1_no_eval_rate = safe_divide(df[col_noeval1], df[col_enr1])
sem1_pass_rate = safe_divide(df[col_approved1], df[col_eval1])

# Semester 2 internal consistency before computing participation and pass rates
# ASSERTION_START
assert ((df[col_eval2] >= 0) & (df[col_noeval2] >= 0) & (df[col_enr2] >= 0) & (df[col_eval2] + df[col_noeval2] == df[col_enr2])).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# ASSERTION_START
assert ((df[col_approved2] >= 0) & (df[col_eval2] >= 0) & (df[col_approved2] <= df[col_eval2])).all()
# ASSERTION_END
sem2_participation = safe_divide(df[col_eval2], df[col_enr2])
sem2_no_eval_rate = safe_divide(df[col_noeval2], df[col_enr2])
sem2_pass_rate = safe_divide(df[col_approved2], df[col_eval2])

# Financial status exclusivity before using it as a binary feature
# ASSERTION_START
assert df[col_debtor].isin([0, 1]).all()
assert df[col_tuition].isin([0, 1]).all()
assert ((df[col_debtor] + df[col_tuition]) == 1).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# Financial pressure
financial_risk = df[col_debtor].astype(float)

# Economic environment scaler (bounded into [0,1] roughly for typical values)
unemp_scaled = (df[col_unemp] / 20.0).astype(float).clip(0.0, 1.0)

# Scholarship and preference signals
no_scholar = (1 - df[col_scholar]).astype(float)
not_first_choice = (df[col_app_order] != 1).astype(float)

# Risk model (weekly heuristic)
risk_score = (
    0.30 * (1.0 - grade1_norm)
    + 0.15 * (1.0 - sem1_pass_rate.clip(0, 1))
    + 0.10 * (1.0 - sem2_pass_rate.clip(0, 1))
    + 0.10 * ((sem1_no_eval_rate + sem2_no_eval_rate) / 2.0).clip(0, 1)
    + 0.15 * financial_risk
    + 0.05 * no_scholar
    + 0.05 * not_first_choice
    + 0.10 * unemp_scaled
)

risk_score = pd.Series(np.clip(risk_score, 0.0, 1.0), name='risk_score', index=df.index)

# Calibrate intervention quotas; downstream logic assumes a majority of order==1
order1_share = (df[col_app_order] == 1).mean()
# ASSERTION_START
assert order1_share >= 0.65
# ASSERTION_END
n = len(df)
weekly_capacity = max(25, int(np.ceil(0.10 * n)))
order1_quota = int(np.floor(0.65 * weekly_capacity))
other_quota = int(max(0, weekly_capacity - order1_quota))

# Select top-k within preference groups (relies on having enough order==1 records)
order1_mask = df[col_app_order] == 1
orderN_mask = ~order1_mask

order1_top_idx = df.loc[order1_mask].nlargest(order1_quota, columns=['risk_score'], keep='all') \
    .index if 'risk_score' in df.columns else df.assign(risk_score=risk_score).loc[order1_mask].nlargest(order1_quota, 'risk_score').index

# Ensure risk_score column exists for nlargest usage consistently
df = df.assign(risk_score=risk_score)

order1_top_idx = df.loc[order1_mask].nlargest(order1_quota, 'risk_score').index
other_top_idx = df.loc[orderN_mask].nlargest(other_quota, 'risk_score').index

selected_idx = pd.Index(order1_top_idx.tolist() + other_top_idx.tolist())
flag_for_advising = df.index.isin(selected_idx)

# Priority ranks for queueing
priority_rank = df['risk_score'].rank(method='first', ascending=False).astype(int)

# Summaries for monitoring
now_ts = dt.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + 'Z'
summary = {
    'generated_at': now_ts,
    'records': int(n),
    'weekly_capacity': int(weekly_capacity),
    'selected': int(flag_for_advising.sum()),
    'order1_share': float(order1_share),
    'avg_risk_all': float(df['risk_score'].mean()),
    'avg_risk_selected': float(df.loc[flag_for_advising, 'risk_score'].mean()) if flag_for_advising.any() else 0.0,
}

# Persist outputs
scores_out = df[['student_id', 'risk_score', col_app_order, col_debtor, col_tuition, col_target]].copy()
scores_out['flag_for_advising'] = flag_for_advising
scores_out['priority_rank'] = priority_rank

scores_csv = os.path.join(args.output, 'dropout_risk_scores.csv')
scores_out.to_csv(scores_csv, index=False)

queue_out = scores_out.loc[scores_out['flag_for_advising']].sort_values(['risk_score', 'priority_rank'], ascending=[False, True])
queue_csv = os.path.join(args.output, 'advising_queue.csv')
queue_out.to_csv(queue_csv, index=False)

summary_json = os.path.join(args.output, 'weekly_summary.json')
with open(summary_json, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)

print(json.dumps({'status': 'ok', 'outputs': {'scores_csv': scores_csv, 'queue_csv': queue_csv, 'summary_json': summary_json}}, indent=2))
